chapterInfo.content:
9
Hiob mmuaeɛ. Obi ntumi ne Otumfoɔ nni asie
1Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
2 # Hiob 25.4 Ampa ara, menim sɛ ɛte saa,
na ɔdasani bɛtene wɔ Nyankopɔn anim sɛn?
3 # Dwom 19.12 Sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔne no yiyi ano a,
ɔntumi mmua no apem mu baako mpo.
4Akoma mu nyansafoɔ ne tumi mu hoɔdenfoɔ no,
hwan na wasene ne kɔn wɔ ne soɔ na asi no yie?
5Ɔtutu mmepɔ mpatuo mu,
ɔbutu no n’abufuo mu.
6Ɔwoso asase firi n’atenaeɛ,
na ne nnyinasoɔ popo.
7Ɔhyɛ owia, na ɛmpue;
na ɔsosɔ nsoromma ano.
8 # Yes 40.22 Ɔno nko na ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu,
na ɔtiatia po asorɔkyeɛ so;
9 # Hiob 38.31; Amos 5.8; Yes 13.10 ɔyɛ Nsorommason, Nwenwenente ne Akokɔbaatan-ne-ne-mma
ne anafoɔ fam mpiakyire.
10 # Hiob 5.9 Ɔyɛ ade akɛseɛ a ɛnni nhwehwɛmu
ne anwanwadeɛ a wɔntumi nkan.
11Hwɛ, ɔnam me ho, nso menhu no,
ɔsene, nso menhu no.
12Hwɛ, ɔhwim kɔ, hwan na ɔbɛsane no?
Hwan na ɔbɛbisa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi?
13 # Hiob 26.12 Onyankopɔn rensianka n’abufuo,
Rahab aboafoɔ brɛ wɔn ho ase wɔ n’ase.
14Na nkantom sɛ me na mɛbua no,
anaasɛ mɛhwehwɛ me nsɛm mu, na me ne no ayiyie.
15Ɔno na sɛ metene mpo a, meremmua no,
mɛkoto no sɛ me temmufoɔ.
16Sɛ mefrɛ na ɔgye me so a,
merennye menni sɛ wayɛ aso ama me nne.
17Ɔno a ɔde ahum posa me,
na ɔma m’akuro dɔɔso kwa no,
18ɔmmma mennya ahomegyeɛ,
na ɔde awerɛhoɔ hyɛ me ma tɔ.
19 # Hiob 9.33 Sɛ wɔdi no ɔhoɔdenfoɔ tumi so a, anka: Ɔnnie!
Na sɛ atemmuo nso a, anka: Hwan na ɔbɛsane no?
20Sɛ metene mpo a, anka m’ano bɛbu me fɔ,
na medi mu mpo a, ɔbɛma makyea.
21Me deɛ, medi mu deɛ, nanso memmu me ho;
me nkwa afono me.
22 # Hiob 8.20; Skf 9.2-3 Ne nyinaa yɛ bafua; enti na mese:
Deɛ ɔdi mu ne ɔbɔnefoɔ nyinaa na ɔsɛe wɔn.
23Sɛ atoyerɛnkyɛm kum obi mpofirim a,
ɔseresere wɔn a wɔdi bem amaneɛ.
24Wɔde asase ahyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ nsa,
ɔkata n’atemmufoɔ ani.
Sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a, na ɛyɛ hwan a?
25Na me nna ho yɛ hare sene mmirikatuni;
ɛdwane kɔ, ɛnhunu adepa biara.
26Ɛsene kɔ sɛ demmire nkyɛkyerɛ hyɛn,
sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔsi aduane soɔ.
27Sɛ mese: Me werɛ bɛfiri m’apinisie,
mɛgyae mosooyɛ na mate m’anim a,
28me yea nyinaa yɛ me hu,
ɛfiri sɛ mehunu sɛ woremmu me bem.
29Na sɛ wɔbɛbu me fɔ a,
adɛn nti na memmrɛ nguo?
30Sɛ medware sukyerɛmma nsuo
na mede dɔw mehohoro me nsa a,
31ɛno nso wode me bɛto amena mu,
na me ho ayɛ me ntadeɛ mpo nwunu.
32Na ɔnyɛ onipa sɛ me, na mabua no,
na yɛn baanu ahyiam abɔ nkuro.
33Nso ntamgyinafoɔ bi nni yɛn ntam a
ɔde ne nsa bɛto yɛn baanu soɔ.
34Ma no nyi n’abaa mfiri me so,
na ne ho hu ankuta me.
35Ɛnna anka mɛkasa a merensuro no,
nanso mentumi nyɛ saa wɔ me ara m’afam.

Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
Ampa ara, menim sɛ ɛte saa,
na ɔdasani bɛtene wɔ Nyankopɔn anim sɛn?
Sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔne no yiyi ano a,
ɔntumi mmua no apem mu baako mpo.
Akoma mu nyansafoɔ ne tumi mu hoɔdenfoɔ no,
hwan na wasene ne kɔn wɔ ne soɔ na asi no yie?
Ɔtutu mmepɔ mpatuo mu,
ɔbutu no n’abufuo mu.
Ɔwoso asase firi n’atenaeɛ,
na ne nnyinasoɔ popo.
Ɔhyɛ owia, na ɛmpue;
na ɔsosɔ nsoromma ano.
Ɔno nko na ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu,
na ɔtiatia po asorɔkyeɛ so;
ɔyɛ Nsorommason, Nwenwenente ne Akokɔbaatan-ne-ne-mma
ne anafoɔ fam mpiakyire.
Ɔyɛ ade akɛseɛ a ɛnni nhwehwɛmu
ne anwanwadeɛ a wɔntumi nkan.
Hwɛ, ɔnam me ho, nso menhu no,
ɔsene, nso menhu no.
Hwɛ, ɔhwim kɔ, hwan na ɔbɛsane no?
Hwan na ɔbɛbisa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi?

Onyankopɔn rensianka n’abufuo,
Rahab aboafoɔ brɛ wɔn ho ase wɔ n’ase.
Na nkantom sɛ me na mɛbua no,
anaasɛ mɛhwehwɛ me nsɛm mu, na me ne no ayiyie.
Ɔno na sɛ metene mpo a, meremmua no,
mɛkoto no sɛ me temmufoɔ.
Sɛ mefrɛ na ɔgye me so a,
merennye menni sɛ wayɛ aso ama me nne.
Ɔno a ɔde ahum posa me,
na ɔma m’akuro dɔɔso kwa no,
ɔmmma mennya ahomegyeɛ,
na ɔde awerɛhoɔ hyɛ me ma tɔ.
Sɛ wɔdi no ɔhoɔdenfoɔ tumi so a, anka: Ɔnnie!
Na sɛ atemmuo nso a, anka: Hwan na ɔbɛsane no?
Sɛ metene mpo a, anka m’ano bɛbu me fɔ,
na medi mu mpo a, ɔbɛma makyea.
Me deɛ, medi mu deɛ, nanso memmu me ho;
me nkwa afono me.
Ne nyinaa yɛ bafua; enti na mese:
Deɛ ɔdi mu ne ɔbɔnefoɔ nyinaa na ɔsɛe wɔn.
Sɛ atoyerɛnkyɛm kum obi mpofirim a,
ɔseresere wɔn a wɔdi bem amaneɛ.
Wɔde asase ahyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ nsa,
ɔkata n’atemmufoɔ ani.
Sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a, na ɛyɛ hwan a?

Na me nna ho yɛ hare sene mmirikatuni;
ɛdwane kɔ, ɛnhunu adepa biara.
Ɛsene kɔ sɛ demmire nkyɛkyerɛ hyɛn,
sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔsi aduane soɔ.
Sɛ mese: Me werɛ bɛfiri m’apinisie,
mɛgyae mosooyɛ na mate m’anim a,
me yea nyinaa yɛ me hu,
ɛfiri sɛ mehunu sɛ woremmu me bem.
Na sɛ wɔbɛbu me fɔ a,
adɛn nti na memmrɛ nguo?
Sɛ medware sukyerɛmma nsuo
na mede dɔw mehohoro me nsa a,
ɛno nso wode me bɛto amena mu,
na me ho ayɛ me ntadeɛ mpo nwunu.
Na ɔnyɛ onipa sɛ me, na mabua no,
na yɛn baanu ahyiam abɔ nkuro.
Nso ntamgyinafoɔ bi nni yɛn ntam a
ɔde ne nsa bɛto yɛn baanu soɔ.
Ma no nyi n’abaa mfiri me so,
na ne ho hu ankuta me.
Ɛnna anka mɛkasa a merensuro no,
nanso mentumi nyɛ saa wɔ me ara m’afam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
